# AdmitOS

AdmitOS is an AI-powered workspace for international university admissions,
scholarships, transfer pathways, and application preparation.

Public pages:
- /universities — university programs and admissions information
- /scholarships — scholarship opportunities
- /pathways — transfer and study pathways

Private workspace pages and APIs require authentication. University
requirements, dates, scholarships, contacts, and source URLs are only
authoritative when the application labels the evidence as current and verified.
The application copilot creates local drafts and does not submit applications.
